title: Abdominal aorta ultrasound
what: The doctor uses ultrasound to look at the main artery in your belly. It shows if it is widened or has plaques.
why: To check for a widened aorta in older men and smokers, for a pulsing feeling in the belly, or with blood vessel disease.
duration: usually 15 to 20 minutes; the report is ready right away
tell_doctor: If you smoke or smoked in the past
If relatives had a widened aorta
High blood pressure or blood vessel disease
If you had surgery on your belly or blood vessels

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually fasting: 6 to 8 hours without food. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Gas
prepare.text: For 1 to 2 days before, eat less food that causes gas: cabbage, beans, fizzy drinks.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: Comfortable clothes, so your belly is easy to uncover.

bring: Past belly ultrasounds or CT scans
steps: Gel is put on your belly
The doctor moves the probe from the top of the belly down to the navel
The width of the aorta is measured in several places
Sometimes the vessels going to the legs are checked too
feel: Cool gel and pressure from the probe on your belly
after: You can eat right away and go back to your day
The report is usually ready right away
If the aorta is widened, the doctor will tell you how often to have checks
red_flags: Sudden severe pain in the belly or back, weakness, or fainting: call emergency services right away

faq.q: Who should have the aorta checked?
faq.a: Usually older men, especially smokers, and people with a family history of a widened aorta.

faq.q: What if my aorta is widened?
faq.a: Most often it is simply watched and measured regularly. Your doctor will decide if treatment is needed.

reminders.text: Abdominal aorta ultrasound tomorrow. Usually fasting: do not eat after dinner. Water is fine.
